answer: This sounds like it could be an emergency. Please contact your veterinarian or an emergency animal hospital right now. In the US you can also call the ASPCA Animal Poison Control Center (888-426-4435) or Pet Poison Helpline (855-764-7661). PawPal+ does not diagnose or treat, so it has paused normal planning.
